origins.name: Freehold Scrapper
origins.description: Raised in salvage lanes and black-market alleys, you know how to turn scraps into leverage.

origins.name: Ledger Apprentice
origins.description: You learned the city through invoices, audits, and the quiet violence of contracts.

origins.name: Salvage Adept
origins.description: Collapsed districts and dead towers taught you to read danger, residue, and forgotten machinery.

origins.name: Grove Exile
origins.description: You came from the wild edges where roots, spores, and old pacts mattered more than coin.

origins.name: Deckhand Cadet
origins.description: You grew up on catwalks and engine decks, trusting timing, grit, and altitude over comfort.

origins.description: Courier, thief, and witness in the undercity, you survived by moving faster than secrets spread.

origins.name: Tidebound Votary
origins.description: Stormglass shrines and oath-heavy harbors trained you to endure pressure and listen for omens.

origins.name: Sandstep Scout
origins.description: Caravan routes and mirage storms taught you to read false horizons and keep moving anyway.

origins.name: Ashmarked Prospector
origins.description: You worked the caldera margins where every haul cost blood, breath, and a little patience.

origins.name: Dreamwake Survivor
origins.description: You returned from a place that edits memory. The world feels real enough, but never simple.
